Tips & Advice

  • ⏱️ Units take ~45 min each. Block calendar time. Don't try to rush through in 10 minutes.
  • 🔄 You can retake quizzes. 80% pass threshold — review the material and try again if needed.
  • 🧪 AI Labs are free practice. No cost, no tokens — experiment with the tools. That's what they're for.
  • 📊 Start with the Scorecard. If you haven't done anything yet, the 10x PMM Scorecard (5 min) is the best entry point.
